       fhir:ElementDefinition.definition [ fhir:value "The following status codes can be returned:\r\n- 'planned' While the contact is planned.\r\n- 'arrived' After registration as arrived but before the starting time (an episode of care has now been created in DIPS).\r\n- 'in-progress' After the starting time has passed.\r\n- 'finished' When the ending time has passed. Out-patient episodes with no ending time will have status 'finished' the next day.\r\n- 'onleave' For in-patients that currently have \"fravær\" registered.\r\n- 'cancelled' For planned contacts with a finish code other than \"ordinarily finished\"." ] ;
       fhir:ElementDefinition.comment [ fhir:value "Note that internal business rules will determine the appropriate transitions that may occur between statuses (and also classes)." ] ;
       fhir:ElementDefinition.min [ fhir:value "1"^^xsd:nonNegativeInteger ] ;
       fhir:ElementDefinition.max [ fhir:value "1" ] ;

       fhir:ElementDefinition.definition [ fhir:value "The following status codes can be returned:\r\n- 'planned' While the contact is planned.\r\n- 'arrived' After registration as arrived but before the starting time (an episode of care has now been created in DIPS).\r\n- 'in-progress' After the starting time has passed.\r\n- 'finished' When the ending time has passed. Out-patient episodes with no ending time will have status 'finished' the next day.\r\n- 'onleave' For in-patients that currently have \"fravær\" registered.\r\n- 'cancelled' For planned contacts with a finish code other than \"ordinarily finished\"." ]
